surfaceWash.$description: The one gradient the design system keeps.

dev.modaal.duet.note: Both stops are the raised surface at different alphas, so the wash reads as a fade rather than as a second colour.

surfaceHero.$description: The wash behind a hero header.

dev.modaal.duet.note: The two-appearance form: each appearance runs down its own surface ramp, so the wash inverts with the page instead of staying a light wash on a dark ground.
